{{Short description|Ukrainian academic administrator}}
[[File:Олександр Володимирович Співаковський.jpg|thumb|Spivakovsky in 2025]]
'''Aleksander Spivakovsky''' ({{langx|uk|Олександр Співаковський|Oleksandr Spivakovskyi}}) is a Ukrainian academic administrator and mathematician. He is the rector of [[Kherson State University]] and a professor and chair of [[informatics]], [[software engineering]], and [[economic cybernetics]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Alexander Spivakovsky |url=https://www.kspu.edu/About/UniversityAdministration/ABC.aspx?lang=en |access-date=2022-09-25 |website=[[Kherson State University]]}}</ref> On October 21, 2016, Spivakovsky was elected an academician and corresponding member of the [[National Academy of Educational Sciences of Ukraine]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Corresponding members |url=http://naps.gov.ua/ |access-date=2022-09-25 |website=[[National Academy of Educational Sciences of Ukraine]]}}</ref>
